events.description: Two hockey players (San Jose Sharks #19 and Dallas Stars #14) engage in a mutual fistfight on the ice, exchanging punches while referees attempt to intervene.

Two hockey players engage in a sustained mutual physical fight on the ice, exchanging punches and grappling while referees attempt to intervene. The player in the white jersey (No. 19) and the player in the black jersey (No. 14) are actively striking each other throughout the sequence.

Two hockey players engage in a mutual physical fight on the ice: one in a white San Jose Sharks jersey (No. 19) and one in a black Dallas Stars jersey (No. 44). They exchange punches, grapple, and fall to the ice while referees attempt to intervene.

After the initial fight, the player in the white jersey (No. 19) is on the ice and appears helpless; the opposing player (No. 44) continues to strike him while he is down, with referees actively intervening to stop the assault.
A player in a Dallas Stars jersey (number 14) is escorted off the ice by a referee after an apparent on-ice altercation; physical contact and restraint are visible.
